narrative.intro: MVM has recorded $234M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. MVM received 6 awards in the period, producing an average award size of $39.1M and obligations that are up 26.0% year over year. The Department of Homeland Security is the principal buyer, accounting for $234M of obligations in FY2026 to date. Security Guards and Patrol Services is the main NAICS market, also totaling $234M in obligations for the period. Historical fiscal-year obligations show $497M in FY21, $769M in FY22, $303M in FY23, $344M in FY24, and $186M in FY25. The FY2026 to date figure of $234M is a partial, fiscal year to date total. Concentration in a single agency and a single market shapes MVM’s FY2026 profile and affects near-term visibility because a small number of awards drives most obligations.
